title: She Walked In Earning £58K. She Walked Out Earning £120K. Six Minutes.
description:
I want to tell you about six minutes. The most important six minutes in Sarah's career.
She walked into a meeting room earning fifty-eight thousand. She walked out earning a hundred and twenty. It was not luck.

This is a slow, precise reconstruction of one salary negotiation — the preparation, the silence, the three choices that changed everything. Told in real time, without shortcuts or tricks.

Every career has a conversation like this one. Most people never have it. Subscribe to Final Hours.
